propositions: Replace manual attempt scheduler in _pai_structured with single bounded Pydantic Agent operation composing S1 output-policy adapter, preserving full request history and stored responses

Implement wire-context projection HistoryProcessor that includes failed ModelResponse on retry wire only when full response tokens plus effective_max_tokens fit within model window, else omits response entirely and raises ContextWindowExceededError for authoritative-input overflow

Attach concision-aware guard to PROMPTED branch (TextOutput) that detects length/max_tokens truncation via finish_reason or provider_details and sends ModelRetry with concision instruction, while keeping NativeOutput branch unchanged with terminal truncation

Share one request budget across all retries by combining base allowance (ceil(eff_max_iter/2)) plus output-retry allowance in constructed UsageLimits, returning bare base for banking/telemetry without per-attempt reset
Exhaust shared output-retry counter through either concision guard ModelRetry or TextOutput validation ModelRetry, with pydantic-ai's unified counter raising UnexpectedModelBehavior when exceeded
Preserve NativeOutput selection, bug-895c grammar-compilation fallback, and terminal truncation semantics via pai_output.guard_capability() while replacing only the manual scheduling loop
